youtube.title: Ek Minute Mein Mahabharat Khatam Karne Wala Yodha Kaun Tha? 🙏 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Ek aisa veer yodha jo sirf ek minute mein poora Kurukshetra ka yuddh khatam kar sakta tha. Ghatotkach ka putra Barbarik, jisne apni maa ko vachan diya tha ki woh hamesha haarne wale ka saath dega. Usके paas teen divya baan the.

Yuddh se pehle Shri Krishna ne Barbarik se daan mein uska shish maang liya, aur Barbarik ne muskurakar apna sheesh arpit kar diya. Krishna ne use vardaan diya ki kalyug mein woh unke naam Shyam se pooja jayega. Aaj Khatu Shyam ji ke roop mein unki pooja hoti hai.

Katha ka strot: Skanda Purana, Kaumarika Khanda, Khatu Shyam parampara.

#Shorts #BarbarikKatha #KhatuShyam #Mahabharat #DevlokKatha
